summary: SmartShunt local probe reviewed: 45/52 pytest cases passed across probe, prior SmartShunt review and MQTT/sun regressions. Seven failing cases reproduce three distinct defects. Final browser runs passed all 18 flow groups: real cloud TimeoutError, running/disabled state, verdict/read-only checks, mobile layout, four tabs, MOCKED success/error states, six main-page navigation and Trucki read-only reload. No application/config fixes made.

critical.issue: False-positive acceptance: omitting Dc/0/Power or sending null/invalid Power still returns passed=true. Normalizer calculates power from voltage/current, and probe live_ok checks normalized output instead of required received fields. All three variants reproduced with FakeClient.

MQTT connect exception after successful TCP preflight escapes probe_smartshunt. Simulated OSError produces actual HTTP 500 through in-process ASGI instead of HTTP200/passed=false/meaningful checks. Lock is released correctly. Public cloud path remains HTTP200 TimeoutError.

minor.issue: Missing portal returns HTTP200/passed=false but checks=[]; reason exists only in current.status_reason. Missing host and concurrent-lock rejection also use this empty-check helper (source review). No explicit read-only check is included in these early failures.

ui_bugs.issue: Existing React console warning: injected data-ve-dynamic span inside option, stack ends in emergent-main.js. Devices remains usable; not introduced by ProbePanel.

integration_issues.issue: Backend supplies empty checks; ProbePanel renders only verdict/meta and never current.status_reason, so user receives no explanation or visible read-only check in the protocol. API behavior reproduced for missing portal; downstream UI omission established by source review, not config mutation.

action_items: Require received, valid raw Voltage/Current/Power/Soc fields for probe acceptance; do not count derived Power as received mandatory telemetry.
Catch MQTT setup/connect/loop and configuration conversion exceptions; return sanitized HTTP200 failed protocol while preserving finally cleanup and lock release.
Populate explanatory checks and confirmed read-only check for all early failures, including missing host/portal and concurrent probe; alternatively also display current.status_reason in ProbePanel.
Retest three defects before local hardware acceptance. Physical LAN SmartShunt verification and actual Trucki/SUN write behavior remain manual/local checks; no W commands were sent.
Investigate pre-existing option instrumentation warning independently if needed.
critical_code_review_comments: smartshunt_probe.py:106-107 accepts smartshunt.py:150-152 calculated power, bypassing the callback's raw required-field requirement at :90-93 after timeout.
smartshunt_probe.py:52-54 and :68-104 only have finally cleanup, not an exception-to-result handler. Only socket preflight exceptions are caught; paho connect exceptions reach FastAPI as 500.
smartshunt_probe.py:36 defaults early-failure checks to []; ProbePanel.jsx:29-45 has no rendering of current.status_reason.

Exact N/portal/battery/290/# subscription and sole R/portal/keepalive publication confirmed by existing FakeClient safety test. Other-instance messages ignored; no W publications observed in probe tests.
Prior iteration_39 freshness, offline optional and Connected verification failures now pass. Public preview/history responses use typed models and no Mongo _id. Main source/config preserved.

success_rate.backend: 86.5% (45/52 cases; 29/34 first run, 2/4 ASGI outcomes, 14/14 MQTT/sun regressions)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of 18 executed final browser flow groups; empty-check integration issue remains from API/source review

test_credentials: No authentication exercised; none required for requested flows.
seed_data_creation: None. No database/config mutation, seed/reset or physical control commands. Global preview telemetry/history remain DEMO/MOCKED. Probe public HTTP200/TimeoutError is real; successful MQTT and adversarial outcomes are MOCKED FakeClient tests. Browser success and HTTP500 are MOCKED route responses, removed before navigation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Export frontend/.env and use PYTHONPATH=/app/backend. New tests intentionally retain failures. Public POST cloud timeout succeeds as structured failure (~4 seconds). ASGI tests monkeypatch config and FakeClient without lifespan/DB/network writes. UI first attempt had a test-only uppercase inner_text assertion mismatch, corrected once; final run passed. Saved run(page)/run_regressions(page) correspond to executed scripts. Tested desktop 1920x1080 per tool constraints and mobile390x844; requested1920x800 not repeated this run. Main-page testing is navigation/load and read-only control reload, not a claim of full physical Trucki/SUN control testing. Logs show only historical resolved implementation exceptions, no new production backend exceptions during public tests; intentional MOCKED500 console entry expected. Probe result is held only in mounted tab state and disappears on tab navigation (observed); persistence was not required.
rca of the issue: Power reproduction: valid SmartShunt identity/Connected/USB, voltage52.7/current-4.2/SoC73.4/native cycles222, but missing/null/bad Dc/0/Power -> normalizer derives-221.3W, probe waits then checks normalized values and falsely passes. Connection reproduction: fake successful socket preflight plus FakeClient.connect raising OSError -> finally releases lock, no except converts failure, ASGI500. Missing-portal reproduction: mocked config portal empty -> _failed_result checks=[] -> typed HTTP200 but ProbePanel never displays state reason. Fix in main agent, then rerun retained regression tests.
